LESSON: WRITING 11.5.1 MECHANICS OF WRITING: PREFIXES AND SUFFIXES

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENT
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.5: Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Prefixes and Suffixes
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Prefixes and Suffixes, part of Strand 11 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8 ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: How can you tell the meaning of a word using a prefix? 2. Which words with suffixes and prefixes are confusing?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify words with prefixes and suffixes from a text,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Prefixes and Suffixes in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. use prefixes and suffixes correctly in sentences,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Prefixes and Suffixes in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. acknowledge the influence of prefixes and suffixes on meaning and formation of words. • Read a text on careers which features words with prefixes and suffixes from print and non-print sources, Learners who may not turn pages to use page turners or be supported by peers. • Write down words with suffixes and prefixes from the text, Learners with manipulation difficulties could use adapted writing materials or type on appropriate adapted digital devices to write. • Formulate a table separating words with similar prefixes, roots and suffixes, with peers, • Infer the meaning of a word from prefixes, 1. How can you tell the meaning of a word using a prefix? 2. Which words with suffixes and prefixes are confusing? 104 • Break down words into prefixes and suffixes, • Listen to a dictated list of words with prefixes and suffixes and write them down, • Formulate sentences using words with prefixes and suffixes, • Fill in blanks in a writing with the correct form of words with prefixes and suffixes, • Search for more examples of words with prefixes and suffixes from books, newspapers, internet among others, with peers.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Prefixes and Suffixes in the Kenya CBC curriculum.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Prefixes and Suffixes together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Collaboration is enhanced as the learner generates lists of words with prefixes and suffixes in groups or pairs.

• Creativity and imagination is enhanced as the learner performs different tasks on prefixes and suffixes.

Values:
Unity is promoted as the learner searches for more examples of words using prefixes and suffixes in groups.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Creative thinking is developed as the learner formulates sentences using different forms of words.

Link to other subjects:

Word formation is related to learning of vocabulary which is subject specific for example in Agriculture and Nutition..
